text_block_list.text:
During a concert, as she gradually began 
to draw attention, she overheard someone 
saying that concerts are for star 
Umamusume, and that they have nothing to 
do with someone who can't even win.

Smart Falcon insisted that wasn't true. 
Even if they don't win the race, an 
Umamusume surely has feelings she wants to 
convey to her fans in her own voice.

"That's why, separate from the Winning 
Live, I want to create a place purely to 
thank the fans. And for that, I need 
everyone's help—"

Smart Falcon's burning passion had guided 
even those Umamusume who previously had no 
interest toward the Grand Live.
